short_en: H&R Block provides help and inspires confidence in its clients and communities everywhere through global tax preparation services, financial products, and small business solutions.
full_en: H&R Block provides help and inspires confidence in its clients and communities everywhere through global tax preparation services, financial products, and small business solutions. We blend digital innovation with human expertise and care to help people get the best outcome at tax time and also be better with money by using our mobile banking app, Spruce. Through Block Advisors and Wave, we help small-business owners thrive with year-round bookkeeping, payroll, advisory and payment processing solutions. H&R Block, Inc. was organized as a corporation in 1955 under the laws of the State of Missouri. A complete list of our subsidiaries as of June 30, 2026 can be found in Exhibit 21 . 11.3 million U.S. assisted tax returns (1) and diluted EPS from continuing operations of $5.69 per share. which was an increase of $0.18, or 12.0%, per share from the prior year. (1) An Assisted tax return is defined as a current or prior year individual or business tax return, including virtual returns, signed by a tax professional and accepted by the client. A DIY online paid return is defined as a current year individual or business tax return that is prepared by the client on our DIY online platform using a paid product and accepted by the client. (2) See " Non-GAAP Financial Information " in Item 7 for a reconciliation of non-GAAP measures.

full_he: H&R בלוק מספק עזרה ומעורר השראה אמון בלקוחותיה ובקהילותיה בכל מקום באמצעות שירותי הכנת מס גלובליים, מוצרים פיננסיים ופתרונות עסקיים קטנים. אנו משלבים חדשנות דיגיטלית עם מומחיות אנושית וטיפול כדי לעזור לאנשים לקבל את התוצאה הטובה ביותר בזמן המס וגם להיות טוב יותר עם כסף על ידי שימוש באפליקציית הבנקאות הניידת שלנו, Spruce. באמצעות ה-block Advisors ו- Wave, אנו מסייעים לבעלי עסקים קטנים לשגשג עם פתרונות עיבוד ספרים, שכר, ייעוץ ותשלום.
